name: Smith Machine Incline Bench Press
steps: Incline the bench and position it so the bar tracks over your upper chest.
Lie back with feet planted and grasp the bar just outside shoulder width.
Set your shoulder blades against the pad before releasing the hooks.
Lower the bar smoothly down toward your upper chest while keeping your elbows angled roughly 45 degrees from your torso.
Press the bar straight back up along the rails to full arm extension.
tips: Keep your hips and upper back pressed firmly against the bench instead of arching into a flat-bench angle.
Keep your wrists straight directly above your forearms throughout the press.
